verdict.rationale: Orb has some adjacent review and history features for billing configuration. You can test pricing changes against historical usage and preview invoice impact before saving a subscription edit. It also keeps an audit trail of every plan assignment on a subscription. None of this is described as versioning or rolling back automations such as dunning, alerts, or auto-issuance rules. Missing for 10: explicit versioning of automation or workflow definitions, a rollback or revert mechanism, review/approval flows for automation changes, and independent corroboration.
